observed_result: MVP2B safe-stopped with AMBIGUOUS_MVP2A_READY_CLONE after multiple successful MVP2A reruns created multiple CLONE_READY markers.
root_cause: MVP2B treated multiplicity of READY markers as semantic ambiguity even when multiple markers represented byte-equivalent clones of the same verified Darwinex environment.
correction: Validate every READY marker against its exact MVP2A final PASS receipt, source/reconstructed manifest hashes, derived evidence bundle SHA-256, and current clone byte parity.
Deduplicate only candidates with the same active install root, active data root, source manifest SHA-256, and reconstructed clone manifest SHA-256.
If all valid candidates collapse to one equivalence class, select a deterministic ordinal run_id representative; do not select by timestamp or newest file.
If multiple non-equivalent content classes remain, fail closed with AMBIGUOUS_MVP2A_READY_VARIANTS.
If no valid authoritative candidate remains, fail closed with NO_VALID_MVP2A_READY_CLONE.
Persist candidate audit and selection receipt before any MT5 launch attempt.
scientific_scope: Infrastructure-only correction. No change to Candidate3, alpha, risk, portfolio rules, holdout, CERT, or deployment authority.
